cover: What an investor will ask to see

slides.title: Signed IP assignments
slides.body: Agreements assigning contractor-built code to the company. A paid invoice doesn't settle every ownership question.

slides.title: A list of outside code licenses
slides.body: Every license in the codebase, listed so a reviewer can check it.

slides.title: Running costs, today and at 10x
slides.body: The current bill and a model at ten times the load, with assumptions and unmeasured line items marked.

slides.title: Security evidence
slides.body: Sign-in, access control, stored secrets, exposed data and vulnerable dependencies, plus issues you already know about.

slides.title: Who knows what
slides.body: Systems only one person understands, what's undocumented, and what happens if that person leaves mid-deal.

slides.title: Architecture against the roadmap
slides.body: Whether the system can carry the next 18 months, and any plan that depends on an unbudgeted rewrite.
